580:t_1:8.en:
$$桂$$
「Worst case, a whole horde of $$バアル$$ could come pouring out of that hole.」

580:t_1:9.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Space-time could collapse before that happens.」

580:t_1:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「As for the three keys... It seems the third $$特異点$$ wasn't Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

580:t_1:11.en:
$$オルソン$$
「She was the $$特異点$$ of the $$ウィスパード$$ phenomenon, but with her ability gone, we should assume $$サイデリアル$$'s key is someone else.」

580:t_1:13.en:
$$桂$$
(Thanks to $$レナード$$ treating me as an enemy, I'm starting to see who that third person is...)

580:t_1:17.en:
$$桂$$
(If it's that person, we need to be careful. Anyone in that group has to be seriously twisted...)

580:t_1:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So our search for the three keys is back to square one...」

580:t_1:19.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then asking the source of that information directly would be the quickest way.」

580:t_1:20.en:
$$オルソン$$
「You mean $$サイデリアル$$...」

580:t_1:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Our arrival on $$蒼の地球$$ spurred each of the three $$リアクター$$s into action. As a result, their fronts in various areas have gradually thinned out.」

580:t_1:22.en:
$$万丈$$
「Preparations for the counteroffensive should have progressed in the meantime, too.」

580:t_1:23.en:
$$桂$$
「So all we have left is to pick the right time to go.」

580:t_1:24.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ may show up there, too...」

580:t_1:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems they're secretly manipulating the history of various worlds.」

580:t_1:26.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's a good opportunity. I'd like to finally clarify the connection between the fundamental calamity and $$サイデリアル$$.」

580:t_1:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But before that, we have something to settle.」

580:t_1:28.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You mean $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

580:t_1:29.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Their strength has fallen with $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$ザフト$$ leaving. They may try a desperate move to turn things around.」

580:t_1:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$ will likely be the focal point of that battle.」

580:t_1:31.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It holds something powerful enough to overthrow the $$地球連邦$$...」

580:t_1:32.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it falls into $$フル・フロンタル$$'s hands, cunning as he is, he'll use it to break up the forces opposing the Empire in each region.」

580:t_1:33.en:
$$万丈$$
「I want to avoid that at all costs at this stage.」

580:t_1:34.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't like it... That gentleman always comes up with such practical schemes.」

580:t_1:35.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's what makes him different from $$シャア$$.」

580:t_1:36.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is a thorough realist. He won't let an opportunity slip by.」

580:t_1:37.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To prepare to face him, $c apparently plans to finish resupplying at the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

580:t_1:38.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that will be where we fight the decisive battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

580:t_1:39.en:
$$桂$$
「The fight over $$ラプラスの箱$$ that began in the $$時獄戦役$$ is finally reaching its climax.」

580:t_1:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「It may be inappropriate, but after all this, I am curious about what's inside the Box.」

580:t_1:41.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We should leave the decision to reveal it to those entrusted with the Box.」

580:t_1:42.en:
$$桂$$
「You mean $$バナージ$$ and Princess $$ミネバ$$.」

580:t_1:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like to believe they'll use its power to build a future...」

580:t_1:47.en: ～$$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader's　Private Quarters～

580:t_1:48.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Does your telling me the truth mean you acknowledge me as the inheritor of humanity?」

580:t_1:49.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That depends on what you do from now on.」

580:t_1:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand. Then I shall seal away the Box through my own efforts.」

580:t_1:51.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To save humanity from despair.」

580:t_1:52.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be expecting great things from you.」

580:t_1:55.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But is that humanity's limit...?」

580:t_1:56.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(That is how it is, $$シャア・アズナブル$$... And you, $$バナージ$$...)

580:t_1:57.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(It seems the battle to decide our future, and humanity's as well, is coming to an end.)

580:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As the proprietor, $$ＡＧ$$, is absent today, we will operate $$Ｄトレーダー$$ through our unattended sales service.」

580:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that celebrations for ace pilots will be deferred to another occasion.」

580:t_10:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'd heard he was a very amusing person and was looking forward to meeting him. That's a shame.」

580:t_10:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then, Big Sis, I'll do that bit...!」

580:t_10:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's give it our aaaall today!」

580:t_10:14.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「$$オオタ・カズミ$$... Your registration is complete.」

580:t_10:16.en:
$n
(Don't tell me... you got caught in the $$時空震動$$...?)

581:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...The distortion in the dimensional boundary... has subsided.」

581:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It seems we made it back.」

581:t_000:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「All $c personnel are safe, too.」

581:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Things turned out just as $$クロウ$$ said.」

581:t_000:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Look at the center of that hole!」

581:t_001:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are they forcibly suppressing the dimensional distortion...?」

581:t_001:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm sure they're... trying to protect Earth from whatever comes out of there.」

581:t_001:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「This should keep $$バアル$$'s attacks in check for now.」

581:t_001:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Preparations for counteroffensives in every region are coming together. The time has come for $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ to enter its final phase.」

581:t_001:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So it's the decisive battle with the Empire...」

581:t_001:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「There are things we must do before that...」

581:t_001:8.en:
$$青山$$
「For now, have you put your regrets to rest, $$クロウ$$?」

581:t_001:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'm asking you, chief. Let this be the last time you drag all of us along when you draw the short straw.」

581:t_001:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, exactly. I never thought you'd even use a $$時空震動$$ to go help people.」

581:t_001:12.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Your volunteer spirit puts even the crowd at $$陣代高校$$ to shame.」

581:t_001:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm sorry. ...And while we're at it, put that treat I owe you on my tab.」
